kurz: The meat got too hot inside. The fibres have squeezed out their juice.
bild_im_kopf: Like a wrung-out towel: the water has not vanished, it has been squeezed out.

ursachen.warum: Above about 66 °C the fibres contract strongly and lose a lot of juice.
fix: Take it off a few degrees before the target; it carries on cooking
Exception, poultry: always at least 70 °C at the core; salt or brine keeps it juicy

ursachen.warum: Chicken breast and pork fillet have hardly any fat or connective tissue to make them seem juicy.
fix: Or put it in a brine for 1–2 hours

ursachen.titel: Too hot and too long in the oven
ursachen.warum: At a high oven temperature the edge overcooks while the centre catches up.
Right after cooking more juice runs out, and the meat seems drier on the plate.

q1.frage: Did you cook with a thermometer?

q2.frage: Was it a lean cut such as chicken breast or pork fillet?

q3.frage: Did you cut it straight after cooking?
